name: external_peg_nominal_ppo_v3_native_horizon_rejection
reason: The custom recovery environment was not nominally equivalent when intervention_probability was zero. Its dynamic blocker was still reset and force-held directly on the unobserved insertion axis, contaminating the nominal controller task.
